✨ AI Assistant

No AI key yet. The Smart Assistant still reads hotel requests on its own; add your key in Settings → AI Assistant so it can also read pictures and PDFs, and fill letters, training programmes, venues and tours.

Tell me what you need — or paste the client’s email, WhatsApp message or rooming list. I work out whether it is a hotel booking, a training programme, invitation or confirmation letters, a venue booking or a tour, fill the right form using your saved hotels, rates, clients, groups and people, and tell you what to check before you save. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

Try:

Describe the event in plain English. The AI fills the whole Training form — programs, dates, venue, fees, hotel nights and airport transfers — and pulls each participant's details from your People Directory by name. You then review and Save. Nothing is created without your review.

Ask about your documents, clients, payments and outstanding balances. A compact summary of your records is sent to Claude to answer — avoid this tool if you'd rather not send client data.

📊 VAT Report

Output VAT (collected on your Tax Invoices) minus Input VAT (paid on purchase bills) = net VAT payable to the Revenue Department. Filter by date for a monthly or quarterly return; leave dates empty for all‑time.

🔤 Document Font — applied to printed Invoices, Bills, Receipts & Reservation Letters

System fonts (Georgia, Arial, Times…) always work offline. Web fonts (Roboto, Inter, Lato…) need internet when you print or save as PDF. For your brand font, pick Custom (uploaded) and upload the font file.

✨ AI Assistant

Choose a provider and paste that provider's API key to enable the AI tools. The key is stored only in this browser and is sent directly to the provider when you use AI. Google Gemini has a free tier (get a key at aistudio.google.com, no card needed). OpenAI and Claude are pay-as-you-go. Don't host this file publicly with a key in it.

Data & Backup

Saved automatically in this browser. Backup often (keep the file in Google Drive); Restore to load it back on any computer.

📊 CSV Import / Export — bulk-fill from Excel

Have lists in Excel? Template downloads the exact columns → fill them in → Save As CSV → Import. Import adds new rows and updates existing ones (matched by name). Export any module to CSV anytime. Tip: take a JSON Backup first.

🎯 Sales & Delivery Pipeline

Track every opportunity from first enquiry through to closure. Drag a card between columns — or use the ◀ ▶ buttons — as it progresses: Lead → Proposal → Quotation → Invoice → Payment → Delivery → Certificate → Closure. Open a card to link its real quotation, invoice and training booking so the board shows live status. The percentages are win‑probability weights used for the forecast.
